mastery_task.scenario_en: You meet a new person before an evening class.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: تقابل شخص جديد قبل محاضرة مسائية.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Start the conversation, ask how the person is, react, and close.
mastery_task.support: Situation icon only; no dialogue, sentence frame, or answer-bearing model.
mastery_task.freshness: The time, partner, and reported feeling differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: You meet a new volunteer at a community centre.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: تقابل متطوع جديد في مركز مجتمعي.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Open a short conversation, respond to how the person feels, and say goodbye.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Situation icon only; no dialogue, sentence frame, or answer-bearing model.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: A new partner and feeling make this equivalent but not repeated.

rubric.level_2: The reaction matches the partner's stated feeling.
All four social moves are present and intelligible.
The exchange fits the new class setting without reciting the model.
A key unclear social word can be repeated or repaired.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح ليه That's good لا تناسب شخص قال I'm tired، واذكر رد مناسب.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Respond to a different feeling and close.
Open a morning exchange with a new partner.
Complete a fresh four-move social exchange.
